title: PurrPurr SMP
body:
A modpack for [Nikokku](https://discord.gg/JcxWhnzqjA)'s community. All included mods are listed in [this collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/Qu30nNx1) which is always up to date with the latest modpack version.

The modpack contains mostly QoL and optimizations with a few decoration and terraforming mods added for some vanilla enhancement. I try not to stray too far away from the vanilla feeling with this pack.
